# The Harness Lab — Products and Engineering Reference

> The Harness Lab (https://theharnesslab.com/) is a software company. Spencer Teague, a self-taught software engineer in San Angelo, Texas, finds a job in any industry that can be automated, then builds software that does it better, cheaper and faster than a person. Live now: Title-Desk, Artificial Landman, and AI Landman automate mineral title work. Also shipped: BrandStreams, APEX.BUILD, and Wealth & Powers OS. Every customer of a product uses the same software, paid per run or by subscription. The Harness Lab LLC owns the code and IP.

## 2. Operating Method: Three Optical Gates & Twelve Failure Controls

Raw AI wrappers guess, stall, and report completion while customer work remains incomplete. Every Harness Lab system routes work through three deterministic verification gates:

1. **Gate I — Ground:** Start from primary-source documents, recorded instruments, or live verified feeds rather than model memory alone.
2. **Gate II — Verify:** Cross-examine outputs with deterministic code rules and an independent model that took no part in generating the initial answer.
3. **Gate III — Release:** Enforce budget caps, drawdown envelopes, and rate limits mechanically in code, requiring explicit human sign-off before any action spends funds, sends external messages, publishes content, or deletes records.

### Twelve Failure Modes Diagnosed & Controlled

1. **Dropped messages:** Fixed via acknowledged queues, bounded retries, and monitored dead-letter lanes.
2. **Runaway spend:** Fixed via hard budget caps, retry ceilings, and difficulty-tiered model routing.
3. **429 rate-limit storms:** Fixed via exponential backoff with jitter, per-lane concurrency limits, and isolated provider fallback lanes.
4. **Status theater:** Fixed via end-to-end canary tasks that verify real job completion rather than process liveness.
5. **Silent workers:** Fixed via heartbeats, stall detection, and a sourced execution ledger.
6. **Secret leaks:** Fixed via scoped identities, environment templates, and redaction guards across logs, prompts, and repositories.
7. **Missing approval gates:** Fixed via owner checkpoints in web, CLI, email, Slack, or Telegram before consequential actions.
8. **Browser fragility:** Fixed via isolated browser sessions, identity verification, and per-step screenshot evidence.
9. **Duplicate work:** Fixed via idempotency keys and claim-based work queues for exact-once processing.
10. **No recovery path:** Fixed via rehearsed backup restores and written incident recovery playbooks.
11. **Model mismatch:** Fixed via explicit per-role model lanes matching reasoning strength to task risk.
12. **No handoff proof:** Fixed via automated smoke tests, operator runbooks, and evidence bundles verified on the client's own hardware before sign-off.

## 3. Custom In-House AI Harnesses

Off-the-shelf agent frameworks stalled or misreported test state on multi-month builds, so The Harness Lab engineered three proprietary harnesses used across internal and client builds:

### III·A · Rogue Agents (`https://theharnesslab.com/#rogue-agents`)
- **Role:** Multi-agent desktop command center for macOS and Linux.
- **Telemetry (as of November 2026):** 22,582 authored lines of code · 103 commits · 730 / 730 tests passing · built in a 1-month rapid sprint.
- **Capabilities:** Runs Claude, Codex, Antigravity, and Grok side by side across isolated provider lanes with subordinate Ollama Cloud workers; isolates every execution job inside its own Git worktree; requires a four-agent council plan-endorsement vote and independent cross-provider verification before merge.

### III·B · Perihelion Loop (`https://theharnesslab.dev/#perihelion-loop`)
- **Role:** Autonomous create, fix/harden, and lawful no-copy reverse-engineering harness.
- **Telemetry (as of November 2026):** 30,079 authored lines of code · 62 commits · 5 cockpit zoom stages · built in a 1-month rapid sprint.
- **Four Architectural Pillars:**
  1. **Andrej Karpathy's Keep-or-Revert Loop:** Measure baseline -> single-hypothesis edit -> hard programmatic holdout check -> promote strictly improving commits or automatically git-revert regressions -> persist failed hypotheses in an institutional attempt ledger.
  2. **Typed Loops & Graphs DAGs:** Decomposes multi-milestone builds into parallel worktree DAG nodes with unit-scoped retry and a single human gate at irreversible boundaries.
  3. **Hardened Cloudroom Sandbox Fabric:** Built atop open-source Apache-2.0 `cloudroom.dev` Linux VM sandboxes with pre-execution SHA-256 exact-bytes manifest checks, host/token isolation, quarantined output pull, and local holdout verification.
  4. **Sealed Frontier Council:** Multi-provider architectural and adversarial review across Claude, Gemini, OpenAI Codex, and Grok inside read-sealed sandboxes with strict quota governance.
- **Three Production Modes:**
  - *Create:* Full-stack web platforms and staged native desktop foundations (including the 29-feature behavioral specification, 15-screen macOS design, and Phase-1 SwiftUI foundation for Kiln) from product brief to executable acceptance tests.
  - *Fix & Harden:* Enforces `null_tested_regression` gates proven across 7,070 passed / 0 failed checks in 431 Title-Desk test files and 730 / 0 checks on Rogue Agents.
  - *Lawful No-Copy Reverse-Engineering:* OS kernel-walled (`sandbox-exec` on macOS, `bubblewrap` on Linux) study-to-spec separation where downstream build workers are kernel-blocked from reading the studied subject and mechanically verified for zero code, text, identifier, or asset overlap.

### III·C · Mythos OS (`https://theharnesslab.com/#our-os`)
- **Role:** Studio-wide operational cockpit unifying 15 captured live operator surfaces.
- **Telemetry (as captured, November 2026):** 28,734 authored lines of code · 7 connected harnesses · 60 reusable skills · 20,911 Graphify knowledge-graph nodes across 164 communities · 15/15 infrastructure connections online · Hermes orchestrator across 296 sessions and 15,299 messages.
- **Modules:** Mission Control, Harnesses Under One Roof, Hermes Orchestrator, Unified Console, Audit Kit, Public-Source Research Platform, The Forge Brief Composer, Sourced Work Ledger, Graphify Memory Graph, Skills Library, Dream Nightly Review, Connections, Metadata-Redacted Remote Files, Mail Desk, and Quota-Aware Settings.

## 4. Shipped Production Platforms & Portfolio

### Title-Desk & Title-Desk Agent
- **Hosted Web Platform:** https://title-desk.com/ (for independent landmen and abstractors)
- **Desktop App (Title-Desk Agent):** https://desktop.title-desk.com/ (Windows, macOS, and Linux)
- **Related Service:** https://theharnesslab.com/landman-title-workflow-automation/
- **Studio Walkthrough Video:** https://theharnesslab.com/#cinema (`PT2M29S` — 2m 29s workspace demonstration from passwordless sign-in and pre-run intake scope check through live 12-deed examination to a delivered 4-sheet draft workbook).
- **Telemetry (August–November 2026):** 262,305 core engine lines of code (plus 22,638 Title-Desk hosted web layer, 23,148 Artificial Landman hosted layer sharing the core engine, and 4,288 TractPilot prototype) · 1,662 campaign commits · 7,070 engine tests · 4-month core engineering campaign.
- **Scope & Validation:** Texas, one county per run, current mineral-interest owners (`MI`) only. Two Gemini sessions examine the records separately, and deterministic code checks every rational fraction exactly. An independent third model from a different provider checks the final answer against page images; if it still disagrees after one repair, unresolved tracts stay proposals and blocking findings lead the curative requirements. Output is a source-linked draft four-sheet workbook for review by a qualified landman or attorney (not a title opinion or certification).

### Artificial Landman
- **Live Platform:** https://artificiallandman.io/
- **Telemetry (November 2026):** 23,148 hosted lines of code · 54 hosted commits · 1-month rapid sprint atop The Harness Lab's 262,305-LOC Texas mineral-interest engine.
- **Capabilities:** Hosted Texas mineral title examination for land teams, brokerages, and operators who run many assignments. Artificial Landman runs the same Texas mineral-interest engine as Title-Desk, sold and supported on its own with a dedicated brass-and-topographic workspace.

### AI Landman
- **Live Platform:** https://ailandman.io/
- **Telemetry (November 2026):** 22,810 service lines of code · 121 commits · 1-month rapid sprint across all 254 Texas counties atop The Harness Lab's 262,305-LOC Texas mineral-interest engine.
- **Capabilities:** Remote Texas oil and gas mineral title examination supporting both uploaded deed packets and full-service county clerk retrieval with operator-approved copy budgets. Two Gemini sessions examine records separately, deterministic code checks every rational fraction, an independent third model audits the final answer against page images, and the source-linked draft Excel workbook arrives by email for review by a qualified landman or attorney.

## 5. Products for sale

1. **Title-Desk (`https://title-desk.com/`):** Landman title research software. Upload or request county records. It reads the documents, builds the chain of title and runsheet, resolves mineral ownership and computes net mineral acres. The hosted web app is paid per run.
2. **Title-Desk Agent (`https://desktop.title-desk.com/`):** The Title-Desk desktop app, sold by subscription. The same software.
3. **AI Landman (`https://ailandman.io/`):** Hosted landman title product on the same platform.
4. **Artificial Landman (`https://artificiallandman.io/`):** Hosted Texas mineral title examination for land teams, brokerages and operators.

Live now: Title-Desk, Artificial Landman, and AI Landman automate mineral title work. Every customer of a product uses the same software. Spencer Teague wrote it. The Harness Lab LLC owns the code and IP.

## 6. Buyer & Technical FAQ

**Q: Who owns the software?**
A: Spencer Teague, a self-taught software engineer in San Angelo, Texas, wrote the software. The Harness Lab LLC owns the code and IP. Live now: Title-Desk, Artificial Landman, and AI Landman automate mineral title work. Every customer of a product uses the same software, paid per run or by subscription.

**Q: How do customers pay, and how do they ask a question?**
A: The Title-Desk desktop app is sold by subscription. The hosted web app is paid per run. Questions go to spencer@theharnesslab.com or https://theharnesslab.com/contact/. Try Title-Desk at https://title-desk.com/, AI Landman at https://ailandman.io/, and Artificial Landman at https://artificiallandman.io/.

**Q: Does Title-Desk or automated landman software replace a qualified title reviewer?**
A: No. Title-Desk, Artificial Landman, and AI Landman produce source-linked draft mineral-ownership workbooks, not title opinions or certifications. Automated extraction, chain-of-title assembly, and exact fractional math accelerate preparation while preserving curative findings and book-and-page source links so a qualified landman or title attorney remains in full control of title conclusions.
